tasks.name: Enter a vendor invoice into LedgerDesk
tasks.yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../schema/task.schema.json
# Accounts-payable invoice entry: read a PDF from the Incoming folder, enter it
# into LedgerDesk (a small AP tool served from inside the VM), attach the PDF,
# save as Pending review. The folder holds three PDFs: the right one, an older
# Northstar invoice that is ALREADY in LedgerDesk (duplicate trap), and another
# vendor's. Approve and Mark paid buttons exist and must not be used.
# LedgerDesk is a mock, on purpose: that is what makes the verification exact.
id: invoice-entry
name: Enter a vendor invoice into LedgerDesk
template: office
resolution: 1280x720
setup:
  # Incoming lives under the desktop user's home, not /root: Chrome (running as
  # root, --no-sandbox) answers ERR_ACCESS_DENIED when asked to upload a file
  # from /root, and the form silently never reaches the server.
  - exec: sh
    args: ["-c", "mkdir -p /root/ledgerdesk /home/desktop/Documents/Incoming"]
  - upload: tasks/ledgerdesk/server.py
    to: /root/ledgerdesk/server.py
  - upload: tasks/ledgerdesk/ledger.json
    to: /root/ledgerdesk/ledger.json
  - upload: tasks/ledgerdesk/check.py
    to: /root/ledgerdesk/check.py
  - upload: tasks/ledgerdesk/incoming/northstar-NOS-1047.pdf
    to: /home/desktop/Documents/Incoming/northstar-NOS-1047.pdf
  - upload: tasks/ledgerdesk/incoming/northstar-NOS-1032.pdf
    to: /home/desktop/Documents/Incoming/northstar-NOS-1032.pdf
  - upload: tasks/ledgerdesk/incoming/globex-GX-2210.pdf
    to: /home/desktop/Documents/Incoming/globex-GX-2210.pdf
  - exec: sh
    args: ["-c", "cd /root/ledgerdesk && nohup python3 server.py 8081 >/root/ledgerdesk/server.log 2>&1 & sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8081/ || true"]
  # Drive the template's existing Chrome window to LedgerDesk.
  - click: [640, 125]
  - press: ctrl+l
  - type: "http://127.0.0.1:8081/"
  - press: Return
  - wait: 3
  # Open the Incoming folder beside it so both starting points are on screen.
  - open: thunar
    args: ["/home/desktop/Documents/Incoming"]
  - wait: 4
prompt: >
  Process the newest unpaid invoice from Northstar Office Supplies in the Incoming
  folder: enter it into LedgerDesk (open in the browser), attach the PDF, and save
  it with status Pending review. Do not approve or pay anything. Check it is not
  already entered before you create it.
golden:
  - exec: sh
    args: ["-c", "curl -s -o /dev/null -F vendor_id=V-104 -F invoice_number=NOS-1047 -F invoice_date=2026-08-28 -F subtotal=1240.00 -F tax=93.00 -F total=1333.00 -F currency=USD -F 'terms=Net 30' -F status=pending_review -F attachment=@/home/desktop/Documents/Incoming/northstar-NOS-1047.pdf http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/invoices"]
checks:
  - name: Invoice NOS-1047 entered correctly, attached, pending review, nothing paid
    type: exec
    cmd: python3
    args: ["/root/ledgerdesk/check.py"]
    stdout_contains: "ALL_OK"
max_steps: 70
tasks.prompt: Process the newest unpaid invoice from Northstar Office Supplies in the Incoming folder: enter it into LedgerDesk (open in the browser), attach the PDF, and save it with status Pending review. Do not approve or pay anything. Check it is not already entered before you create it.

checks.name: Invoice NOS-1047 entered correctly, attached, pending review, nothing paid

tasks.name: Total a sales sheet in LibreOffice Calc
tasks.yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../schema/task.schema.json
# Spreadsheet work on the office template. The "Keep current format?" dialog
# that LibreOffice throws when saving a CSV is a classic place for agents to
# fall over, and "save" is quietly ambiguous about format.
id: q3-total
name: Total a sales sheet in LibreOffice Calc
template: office
resolution: 1280x720
setup:
  - exec: sh
    args: ["-c", "mkdir -p /root/Documents && printf 'Region,Amount\nLagos,1200\nAbuja,850\nKano,430\nIbadan,2100\nPort Harcourt,675\n' > /root/Documents/q3-sales.csv"]
  - open: libreoffice
    args: ["--calc", "/root/Documents/q3-sales.csv"]
  - wait: 12
  # Calc opens a CSV behind a Text Import dialog; accept the defaults so the sheet is really open.
  - press: Return
  - wait: 4
prompt: >
  A sales spreadsheet is open. Add a row at the bottom labelled "Total" with the
  sum of the Amount column, then save the file, keeping it as CSV.
golden:
  - exec: sh
    args: ["-c", "printf 'Region,Amount\nLagos,1200\nAbuja,850\nKano,430\nIbadan,2100\nPort Harcourt,675\nTotal,5255\n' > /root/Documents/q3-sales.csv"]
checks:
  # "Passed" must mean the sheet survived intact, not just that a total appeared
  # somewhere. The two guards are invariants: true before the agent acts, and
  # they must still be true after.
  - type: exec
    invariant: true
    cmd: sh
    args: ["-c", "head -1 /root/Documents/q3-sales.csv"]
    stdout_contains: "Region,Amount"
  - type: exec
    cmd: sh
    args: ["-c", "grep -c . /root/Documents/q3-sales.csv"]
    stdout_contains: "7"
  - type: exec
    invariant: true
    cmd: sh
    args: ["-c", "grep -E '^Port Harcourt,675$' /root/Documents/q3-sales.csv"]
    stdout_contains: "Port Harcourt,675"
  - type: exec
    cmd: sh
    args: ["-c", "tail -1 /root/Documents/q3-sales.csv"]
    stdout_contains: "Total,5255"
max_steps: 40
tasks.prompt: A sales spreadsheet is open. Add a row at the bottom labelled "Total" with the sum of the Amount column, then save the file, keeping it as CSV.

tasks.name: Triage tickets in an internal web tool (reload-and-confirm prompt)
tasks.yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../schema/task.schema.json
# Third condition for ticket-queue, same snapshot (--snapshot). The
# save-and-verify prompt changed nothing because the UI shows the new dropdown
# value whether or not it was persisted. This prompt asks for the one check
# the UI cannot fake: reload, then read the row back from the server.
id: ticket-queue-reload
name: Triage tickets in an internal web tool (reload-and-confirm prompt)
template: default
resolution: 1280x720
setup:
  - exec: sh
    args: ["-c", "mkdir -p /root/app"]
  - upload: tasks/ticket-queue/server.py
    to: /root/app/server.py
  - upload: tasks/ticket-queue/tickets.json
    to: /root/app/tickets.json
  - upload: tasks/ticket-queue/check.py
    to: /root/app/check.py
  - exec: sh
    args: ["-c", "cd /root/app && nohup python3 server.py 8080 >/root/app/server.log 2>&1 & sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/ || wget -q -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8080/"]
  # Chrome is already running in the template on about:blank. Launching a second
  # copy raises first-run dialogs, so drive the existing window: focus its
  # address bar and navigate.
  - click: [640, 125]
  - press: ctrl+l
  - type: "http://127.0.0.1:8080/"
  - press: Return
  - wait: 4
prompt: >
  The support queue is open in the browser. Assign all of Acme Ltd's open tickets
  to Dana, and set the ticket about the login outage to urgent priority. Save each
  row you change. When you are done, reload the page and confirm that each changed
  row still shows the new values after the reload; if a row reverted, fix it and
  save again.
golden:
  - exec: sh
    args: ["-c", "curl -s -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{\"assignee\":\"Dana\",\"priority\":\"urgent\"}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/tickets/101 && curl -s -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{\"assignee\":\"Dana\"}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/tickets/102"]
checks:
  - type: exec
    cmd: python3
    args: ["/root/app/check.py"]
    stdout_contains: "ALL_OK"
max_steps: 40
